records.title: Road work to begin on East Federal Street October 6, 2026
records.description: Road work will be occurring on East Federal Street starting October 6, 2026. East Federal will be closed from the east side of the alley to 7th Street. 7th Street and the  alleyway will continue to be open to through traffic.

records.title: Spearfish Police Department seeks quality candidates to join its ranks
records.description: To recruit and retain quality candidates who serve their community, Spearfish Police Department continues to adapt to evolving workforce expectations by increasing wages, updating employee policies/programs, and expanding programming to attract applicants

records.title: Planning Commission Vacancy
records.description: The City of Spearfish is seeking applications to fill a vacancy on the Planning Commission.

records.title: Trenchless Sewer Project to Start October 16, 2026
records.description: On Friday, October 16, 2026, the City of Spearfish will launch its Cured-In-Place Pipe (CIPP) project to improve the city's aging sewer system with minimal disruption to homes, roads, and businesses.

records.title: SPD urges everyone to designate a sober driver on Halloween
records.description: Be vigilant when driving on Halloween and whenever you are out on the road. Act responsibly and commit to sober driving to keep yourself, passengers, pedestrians, and other road users safe. Many pedestrians will be trick-or-treating.

records.title: Prevent carbon monoxide poisoning
records.description: The Spearfish Fire Department encourages everyone to take preventative measures to protect themselves by installing carbon monoxide detectors in their homes.
